This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced estimator who thrives in a lean environment, enjoys ownership and accountability, and is comfortable operating independently within established systems and procedures
Manage the complete estimating process for commercial earthwork and utility construction projects from bid invitation through proposal submission
Develop complete project estimates and bid proposals
